title: Remove all goal-related UI and show only monthly totals

requirements.text: Remove all goal-related labels and values from each habit row so the habit info cell never shows a "Goal" line and the monthly total area never renders a "/ Goal: …" segment; only show the monthly total value.

quotes: Perfect - if you can just remove goal. There is no goal for this I just want monthly total to show

acceptanceCriteria: In the habit row UI, there is no text "Goal" rendered anywhere (including "Goal: 0").
For non-reps/time habits, the monthly total section shows only "Monthly total: <value>" with no "/" and no secondary value.
For reps/time habits, the monthly total section continues to show only the monthly total (as it does today).

requirements.text: Update the habit edit modal to remove goal-related UI: do not show any field labeled "Monthly Goal" and do not allow editing/storing a per-month goal value. The volume input should only appear for unit types that use per-completion volume ("reps" and "time"); for all other unit types, hide the volume input entirely.

quotes: Perfect - if you can just remove goal. There is no goal for this I just want monthly total to show

acceptanceCriteria: When editing a habit with unit type not equal to "reps" or "time", the modal does not display the volume/goal input at all.
When editing a habit with unit type "reps" or "time", the modal continues to show the "Volume per completion" input and saves as before.
No UI text "Monthly Goal" appears anywhere in the app.

requirements.text: Ensure all habit-related screens/components in the app contain no goal-related copy or UI remnants (e.g., "Goal:", "Monthly Goal"), including empty/zero values, and that monthly totals remain visible wherever they are currently shown.
acceptanceCriteria: A global pass through the habit tracking UI confirms no goal-related strings are rendered anywhere.
Monthly totals still render correctly for all unit types across month tabs.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files in frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Keep the backend single-actor architecture; do not introduce additional canisters/services.
Do not introduce external databases or third-party auth providers (Internet Identity only).
nonGoals: Removing volume-per-completion functionality for "reps" and "time" habits.
Changing how monthly totals are calculated.
Backend schema/state migrations unless strictly required to remove goal UI (prefer no migration).
